status_effects.explanation: Bloch is briefly used as an example of someone who would misunderstand an old aristocratic usage, mildly diminishing him relative to genuine aristocratic knowledge.
His authentic firsthand memory of an old custom affirms his standing as a genuine bearer of aristocratic tradition, in implicit contrast to Bloch.

appraisal_events.evidence: Quant au poêle dont Bloch eût cru sans doute que l'usage était réservé aux enterrements, à cause des cordons du poêle dont on parle dans les comptes rendus d'obsèques
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator imagines Bloch would mistakenly assume the word 'poêle' referred only to funeral usage, presenting him as lacking the authentic cultural knowledge the aristocracy possesses.

appraisal_events.evidence: duc de Guermantes pouvait se rappeler le temps où, encore enfant, il l'avait vu tenir au mariage de M. de Mailly-Nesle.
appraisal_events.explanation: In contrast to Bloch's presumed ignorance, the duke's firsthand childhood memory of the true custom exemplifies the authentic, lived aristocratic knowledge the narrator praises in this passage.
